races.name: Bermingham Cameras Novice Chase
midfield: Uno Me I Like My T

runners_data.name: Sky Lord
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but 38 days off and hasn't won over fences in five attempts
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite at Cork in his first handicap chase, needs to raise his game, tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Rated 130 after five runs over fences without winning; beaten favourite at Cork on handicap chase debut (2m1f, good to yielding); 25l behind in a big-field Listed handicap chase here last time; needs to raise his game but could be best placed to take advantage if the top-rated disappoints.

runners_data.name: Supersundae
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up horse with recent winning form but faces tactical disadvantage against uncontested leader
runners_data.comment: Easy chase winner at Kilbeggan last time; penalised 6lb but should still be hard to beat
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner placed in a Grade 1 before losing his form last year; blasted back to somewhere near his best when landing a Kilbeggan beginners' chase (2m7f, good to yielding) by 17l in April; 2m at Wexford was too sharp for him when 7.5l behind the winner in second, carrying a penalty; rider reduces penalty here and he's undoubtedly the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Ma Jacks Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner gets dream scenario with no pace pressure and wears first-time blinkers
runners_data.comment: Point/m'den hurdle winner was just fair in h'cap hurdles last twice; work to do
runners_data.spotlight: Won his second point-to-point after unseating in his first; 1-5 over hurdles after landing a Gowran maiden in October (2m1f, soft) and is rated 120 over smaller obstacles; some encouragement in his chase debut at Limerick last time when an 18.5l third; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Jolie Jewel
runners_data.note: Inexperienced chaser whose hold-up style is hindered by likely lack of pace
runners_data.comment: Wins over 2m3f and 2m4f over hurdles, this trip may be on the sharp side on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winning hurdler is rated 115 in that sphere; made a positive chasing debut at Ballinrobe last time when third and shaping as though the 2m1f offered by the race was inadequate; can improve but will need to do so radically in this company.

runners_data.name: Uno Me I Like My T
runners_data.note: Out of depth on form with concerning 374-day absence
runners_data.spotlight: All her form in maiden hurdles, points and a bumper says she's out of her depth here.

races.paceDynamic: Ma Jacks Hill will set a sustainable gallop from the front with no other confirmed pace-pressers in this small field. The four hold-up horses (Sky Lord, Supersundae, Jolie Jewel, Uno Me I Like My T) will cluster behind in a waiting game. This creates a tactical race where the front-runner controls proceedings without pressure until the business end. The lack of early pace pressure clearly favours Ma Jacks Hill's prominent style and could make it difficult for the hold-up horses to pick up the pieces in time.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate fractions and kick clear when the field comes to him. Hold-up horses struggle to bridge the gap from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Supersundae or Sky Lord times their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: One of the classier hold-up horses overcomes the tactical disadvantage through superior ability. The front-runner pays for going too slow early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill stops dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader hits the wall and multiple hold-up horses sweep past in a messy finish. Jolie Jewel could benefit from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace scenario creates an unlikely opening for a longer shot
scenarios.body: The tactical nature of the race allows an unfancied runner to steal it. Ma Jacks Hill still holds on for a place.

watchPoints.text: Ma Jacks Hill getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through halfway he's very dangerous
Supersundae's 7lb claiming jockey Anna McGuinness in a tactical race requiring precise timing
Sky Lord's fitness after 38 days off when needing to produce a sustained finish
Jolie Jewel only third chase start and needs strong pace to aim at
Any early mistakes from the hold-up horses when they need every chance in this tactical setup

races.name: Jim Ryan Memorial Novice Chase

runners_data.name: Emily Love
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven class at up to 2m4f but this 3m1f trip represents a stamina question mark despite her tactical advantage.
runners_data.comment: 129-rated hurdler; wouldn't have won but running well when falling on her chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Likes a sound surface and was prolific over hurdles (rated 129) last year, winning five times at up to 2m4f, including a fast-ground victory in America; was running a good race when coming down on chasing debut; benefitted from fall of odds-on favourite when winning over 2m at Tramore, not having much to spare over 112-rated rival.

runners_data.name: Raglan Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs others to come back to him but brings proven class including Martin Pipe third and recent chase-winning form.
runners_data.comment: Well backed to win rated novice chase last time; likely capable of more
runners_data.spotlight: 131-rated hurdler was third to Wodhoodh in last year's Martin Pipe; won rated chase off 124 at Down Royal, pulled up in valuable novice handicap at the festival here last month; pulled up over hurdles on sole previous try over 3m, but that was on bad ground.

runners_data.name: Yoradreamer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has already proven effective over this 3m1f trip at Wexford and carries strong recent form for Willie Mullins.
runners_data.comment: Form of easy beginners' chase win last time doesn't amount to much, but not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden winner over hurdles, rated 118; promise in good beginners' at Gowran and built on that to win four-runner affair over this trip at Wexford, making all; didn't get far in novice handicap at the festival here (hampered and unseated rider) for which he was 40s and Raglan Road was 18/1; wins have come on easy ground, but he handles good.

races.paceDynamic: Emily Love will take this field along from the front in her natural leading role, with Yoradreamer likely to settle prominently in second and Raglan Road held up at the back of this small field. With only three runners and Emily Love unopposed for the lead, she can dictate a steady gallop that won't expose any stamina limitations over this extended trip. The lack of pace pressure from fellow front-runners means Emily Love can control fractions and kick when ready, while Raglan Road will need the leaders to come back to him in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours the front-running and prominent horses who can avoid getting into a staying battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Emily Love Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Emily Love gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: She can quicken off her own tempo when ready and prove hard to pass with only two rivals to see off. Her prolific hurdles form suggests she has the class edge when allowed to dominate proceedings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Yoradreamer Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing and Emily Love's stamina gets exposed over 3m1f
scenarios.body: Yoradreamer can track the leader and strike late, using his Wexford success over this trip as evidence of his staying power. His prominent style allows him to stay in touch without the energy-sapping task of making the running.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Raglan Road's Rally
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and come back to the field in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The 131-rated hurdler can use his hold-up style to sweep past tired leaders, drawing on class that saw him finish third in a competitive Martin Pipe. His proven ability at this level gives him an edge if the race falls apart up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Emily Love sets stronger fractions than expected and all three stay on determinedly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a genuine stamina examination where Yoradreamer's Wexford win over the trip gives him the edge in a slowly-run finish. His recent form suggests he's cherry-ripe for a big effort.

watchPoints.text: Emily Love's stamina reserves over this extended 3m1f trip having previously excelled at shorter distances up to 2m4f
Raglan Road's ability to close the gap from his hold-up position with only two rivals to come back to him in a small field
Yoradreamer's jumping fluency under Anna McGuinness's 7lb claim as any mistakes could prove costly in this tight contest
The early pace development as Emily Love may be able to coast along unopposed and save energy for her finish
Ground conditions affecting each horse's action as the going description shows some variation between Good To Soft and Good To Yielding

races.name: K-Mech Mechanical Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Jalila Moriviere
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 38 days freshness who thrives on good to yielding ground and represents the powerful Mullins stable
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; trounced weak opposition on chase debut at Sligo in October on good to yielding; ran a nice race in a Grade 3 Thurles novice chase in March (2m6f, soft) and bounced back from a poor effort at Fairyhouse when a distant second of 20 in a 2m1f Listed contest last time; firmly in the mix.

runners_data.name: Captain Conby
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 851-day layoff but showing sharpness on recent Flat return for patient connections
runners_data.comment: Should be sharper now following a comeback on the Flat, had very useful form in 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Had very useful form in 2023 and looked sharper for his Flat return after 851 days off the track when a 12l sixth of ten at Wexford (2m, good to yielding); on a nice mark if continuing to shake off his rustiness.

runners_data.name: Me Wee Bonnie Lass
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare wearing tongue-tie who won impressively last time out and handles testing ground conditions well
runners_data.comment: Was 10l winner of Listed mares' handicap at Fairyhouse; 8lb higher now; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; three-time winning hurdler got off the mark over fences in some style when 10l winner of Listed mares' handicap at Fairyhouse (2m5f, yielding to soft); 8lb higher now, but big player if that win wasn't an aberration.

runners_data.name: Karoline Banbou
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose jumping has been fluent lately but tends to get outfinished by classier opponents in the closing stages
runners_data.comment: Second on both completed starts over fences, bids to make amends now for Leopardstown fall
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; beaten favourite in all four beginners' chase starts, the latest of which when 33l behind at Wexford after some jumps lacking in fluency; hard to trust and probably wants softer, but she's dangerous if putting it all together.

runners_data.name: Mister Pink
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has struggled in three chase starts for new yard but may benefit from handicap company
runners_data.comment: Moderate in two starts over fences since returning from over a year off; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; three beginners' chase runs for new yard back from a break haven't been much to shout about; may do better now in a handicap with an opening mark 7lb below his hurdles one.

runners_data.name: Listentillitellyea
runners_data.note: Prominent chaser running just one day after last start who remains winless over fences despite multiple opportunities
runners_data.comment: 0-9 over fences, good ground not ideal latest, rain a plus but others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Has won over hurdles but is 0-9 over fences; ground given as possible excuse for 45l defeat at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good) on return from 295-day break on latest; forecast rain a plus and has run respectably here before but others hold more pressing claims; sixth in 1.50 here on Saturday.

runners_data.name: He's Gorgeous
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing blinkers who won his beginners' chase and ran creditably in Grade 1 company next time
runners_data.comment: Fine fifth of 22 in deep 2m4f novice handicap at Punchestown; good chance if he stays
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't hang around over hurdles and won the second of his beginners' chase starts at Clonmel (2m2f, heavy) in December; fourth of nine in Grade 1 company next time at Leopardstown; kept plugging away when fine fifth of 22 in deep novice handicap at Punchestown festival in May (2m4f, yielding); never involved when favourite in a better Ballinrobe contest last time; blinkers go on, and he's of interest if they sharpen him.

runners_data.name: Ocastle Des Mottes
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who hasn't won for Mullins yet but showed promise when runner-up at Punchestown previously
runners_data.comment: Entitled to come on for first run back at Cork after over a year off and Townend rides
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; dual French hurdles winner is yet to score for this yard but has run well in defeat at times, including when runner-up at Punchestown on chasing debut (2m3f, soft); returned from over a year off at Cork (2m1f, yielding) when 23l fourth behind better-fancied stablemate; makes handicap chase debut now.

runners_data.name: Dutch Schultz
runners_data.note: Hold-up chaser wearing a hood whose best win came at Killarney but has struggled with consistency recently
runners_data.comment: Not a bad run at Fairyhouse after a break, Come On The Lads seems to be yard's number one
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; most recent of two chase wins came in a 2m1f Killarney handicap chase in August 2024; moderate efforts in the autumn and two outings back from a break haven't been much better.

runners_data.name: The Gradual Slope
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying 5lb penalty for recent Fairyhouse win who tends to jump right under pressure
runners_data.comment: Won a Fairyhouse handicap over 2m5f last time; up 5lb so will have to do more; 1lb wrong
runners_data.spotlight: Recorded first win since 2024 when taking a Fairyhouse handicap over 2m5f last time despite jumping right late on; raised 5lb for that so will have to raise his game again, but has won off 4lb higher in the past.

runners_data.name: El Champo
runners_data.note: Prominent chaser whose last win came off 1lb lower rating but failed to complete at Gowran Park latest
runners_data.comment: Third reserve, winner of five races, up against it after two failures to complete
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-winning chaser whose last win came at Listowel in September off 1lb lower (2m6f, good to yielding); looks up against it based on a failure to complete at Gowran over fences and Fairyhouse over hurdles before finishing tailed off here last time.

runners_data.name: Vaureal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who was beaten a head by The Gradual Slope at Fairyhouse and handles testing ground conditions
runners_data.comment: Just denied in recent Fairyhouse handicap; claims on earlier C&D fifth in stronger company
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a head by The Gradual Slope at Fairyhouse in April (2m5f, yielding to soft); creditable effort around the cross-country course at the Punchestown festival last time (3m1f, good to yielding); not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Glenashling
runners_data.note: Prominent chaser wearing hood and tongue-tie who was runner-up on handicap chase debut at Cork in April
runners_data.comment: Second in a six-runner handicap at Cork, officially rated 11lb inferior to Karoline Banbou
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; maiden hurdle winner early last year; runner-up in six-runner Cork contest (2m1f, good to yielding) on handicap chase debut in April; another creditable effort back in a beginners' chase at Wexford (2m, good to yielding) last time, when well ahead of Mister Pink and Karoline Banbou.

races.paceDynamic: Karoline Banbou is the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner field, meaning she can dictate terms without early pressure from The Gradual Slope, Mister Pink and other prominent racers who will likely settle just behind. The sustainable early gallop will allow hold-up horses like Jalila Moriviere, He's Gorgeous and Captain Conby to track the pace before launching late challenges. With minimal early pace pressure and a long straight at Punchestown, this race clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Karoline Banbou sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady through the middle sections.
scenarios.body: The patient riders can time their challenges perfectly up the long Punchestown straight, with class horses like Jalila Moriviere and He's Gorgeous having every chance to show their superior finishing speed. Multiple hold-up horses will be in contention late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If The Gradual Slope or Mister Pink apply more pressure to Karoline Banbou than expected.
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace quickens enough to soften up the hold-up horses, allowing the prominent racers to get first run and hold off late challengers. Horses positioned in second or third early can kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Karoline Banbou goes too slowly early and no other horse takes up the running.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with a blanket finish involving 6-8 horses. Superior class and recent form become decisive factors in a cavalry charge finish where positioning matters less than raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Karoline Banbou improves her jumping and gets into a rhythm that suits her prominent style.
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable lead turning for home while the hold-up horses are still too far back to make meaningful challenges. Her stamina holds out up the hill despite her recent jumping issues.

watchPoints.text: Karoline Banbou's jumping fluency after making multiple errors in recent beginners' chase starts could determine if she sets sustainable fractions
The Gradual Slope's tendency to jump right under pressure may cost him vital ground up the Punchestown straight when the pace lifts
Captain Conby's fitness levels after 851 days off the track, though his recent Flat run suggests he's forward enough
Multiple Mullins and Cromwell runners could complicate the tactical picture if their jockeys don't coordinate early positioning
Me Wee Bonnie Lass and He's Gorgeous both wearing headgear changes that could sharpen their focus for this competitive handicap

races.name: Congratulations Nicole Lockhead Anderson INHSC Ladies Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Act Of God
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran returning from long absence but has winning point-to-point form on similar going last month
runners_data.comment: Old boy had a good career across the codes for the late Edward O'Grady; here for the spin
runners_data.spotlight: Old boy had a good career across the codes for the late Edward O'Grady; had been out of action since summer of 2023 until resuming in point-to-points last month.

runners_data.name: Fenway Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who beat Qaasid in receipt of weight but headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement
runners_data.comment: Entitled to win claiming hurdle last time and nicely weighted here too; big player
runners_data.spotlight: In receipt of plenty of weight from Qaasid when beating that rival in claimer at Clonmel in February; remote second in another claimer a week later; headgear removed for stable debut.

runners_data.name: Cut The Rope
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose Leopardstown fifth over Christmas gives him solid claims on best form
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner on debut, yet to add to that; his fifth of 23 in 2m4f Leopardstown handicap over Christmas would give him a chance; well beaten on bad ground next time; had a spin on the Flat last month.

runners_data.name: Costanuci
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 194-day break with question marks over recent poor hurdles efforts
runners_data.comment: C&D winner in 2023 but recent form leaves her with plenty to find
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner in 2023; couple of good runs over fences last summer; poor efforts over hurdles last two starts and off since November.

runners_data.name: That's About Right
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse having first run over hurdles since 2024, returning to discipline after chasing
runners_data.spotlight: Three hurdle wins but this is his first run in this discipline since 2024; couple of fair runs over fences this year and will like the ground.

runners_data.name: Lakewood Rose
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has been consistent in defeat with two fourths in recent handicaps
runners_data.comment: Well held in a Tramore handicap off 1lb higher last time; improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner has been fourth in first two handicaps and only beaten around 3l over 2m4f at Wexford last time.

runners_data.name: Digby
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in first-time cheekpieces after showing improved travel in visor last time
runners_data.comment: Last year's winner off 9lb higher, in poor form recently, new headgear tried; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Has become hard to predict but travelled a bit better than he often does when fifth in a first-time visor at Ballinrobe; cheekpieces back on now and trip looks too sharp.

runners_data.name: Icare Desbois
runners_data.note: Former Mullins horse likely to lead but sliding handicap mark reflects recent poor form
runners_data.comment: Now looks regressive and was behind some of these at Killarney three weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly useful for Wille Mullins and ran okay in Flat maidens in the autumn, but his recent hurdles form has been poor and mark on the slide.

runners_data.name: Hidalgo Des Mottes
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is long-standing maiden over hurdles despite multiple placed efforts
runners_data.comment: Maiden is best on a sound surface so won't want too much rain; could run well
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of placed efforts but is a long-standing maiden over hurdles; fair Flat run last month; only 11-2 at Clonmel on Friday, but was soundly beaten.

runners_data.name: Mary's Pride
runners_data.note: Prominent performer with stamina concerns over this extended trip, best fresh
runners_data.comment: 6lb below last win, lacks a run but has gone well fresh, cheekpieces on, can't dismiss
runners_data.spotlight: Best form is over 2m and previous attempts over around 2m4f haven't worked out; can go well fresh which he again demonstrated at Ballinrobe, but not sure to back that up.

runners_data.name: Lord Ffrench
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse having second handicap start after modest maiden win, amateur jockey having good season
runners_data.comment: Better than he showed in his previous run in a handicap; has been off since October
runners_data.spotlight: Won modest 2m5f maiden in Sligo last summer; well beaten in two handicap starts, but probably needed return; rider has had a fine year in point-to-points.

runners_data.name: Qaasid
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who got recent Limerick win in stewards' room, looks well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Five Flat wins, 0-11 hurdling, leading when slipped up going to three out at Clonmel
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Britain; rightly got controversial 2m4f Limerick handicap hurdle in the stewards' room after being badly hampered by the first past the post; finished off well that day and likely drier ground here is a positive.

runners_data.name: Cock And Bull
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners_data.name: Fortunate Lighting
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning to hurdles after failed chase debut, won similar contest last summer
runners_data.comment: Rated 111 over hurdles and has a bit to find with some of these on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won 2m5f Sligo handicap on good ground last summer and her reappearance fifth at Bellewstown wasn't a bad effort over a trip too short; tailed off on chase debut last month.

runners_data.name: Adaliz
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with two wins on good ground last summer but returning from 306-day absence
runners_data.spotlight: Two handicap wins on nice ground last summer, over a similar trip to this at Clonmel and then over nearly 3m at Tipperary; off 10 months.

runners_data.name: Fairlander
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut after decent third at Down Royal over similar conditions
runners_data.comment: Much improved on h'cap debut latest, this tougher and 2lb wrong but can't dismiss
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a decent point and ran well on handicap debut when third of 19 at Down Royal (2m4f, yielding) in March; well held at the festival here, but should be competitive back down in grade

runners_data.name: Goin'
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer dropping back from Flat racing for handicap debut with experienced amateur aboard
runners_data.spotlight: Fair performer on the Flat (rated 68) and his latest two runs in that sphere have been fine; experienced rider on board for handicap debut .

races.paceDynamic: Icare Desbois and Digby will likely contest the early lead, with Mary's Pride and Cut The Rope tracking prominently in the second rank. The prominent group should set a reasonable gallop over this intermediate trip on good to yielding ground. With 13 hold-up horses in the field, the pace is unlikely to be overly strong early, but the gallop should build steadily from halfway. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the substantial pace injection that the large contingent of closers will create in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays measured and the prominent horses weaken from 3f out
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up performers get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. Fresh horses like Qaasid and experienced closers like Act Of God can exploit the collapse of the early pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Mary's Pride or Cut The Rope travel kindly behind the leaders without over-racing
scenarios.body: One of the prominent trackers can kick clear when the leaders tire, holding off the wall of closers behind. Their tactical position gives them first strike on horses coming from further back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Icare Desbois sets overly generous fractions and the prominent horses follow too keenly
scenarios.body: The entire front half of the field stops dramatically in the straight, allowing the most patient hold-up horses to sweep past. Only those ridden with maximum restraint early can capitalize on the crawling pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Icare Desbois gets uncontested lead and dictates a steady rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The favourite's former class tells as he controls the race from the front, quickening at the right moment. The hold-up horses are left with too much to do against a horse who has been allowed an easy time of it.

watchPoints.text: Icare Desbois setting unsustainably strong early fractions that could set up pace collapse
Mary's Pride over-racing in prominent position given her tendency to fade over extended distances
Act Of God's jumping and fitness after 1012-day absence from hurdles despite recent point form
Cut The Rope's ability to handle the step up in class from his Christmas Leopardstown effort
Adaliz's readiness after 306 days off despite her proven ability on similar ground conditions

races.name: Lily & Wild Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Hello Below
runners_data.note: Point-to-point winner making hurdling debut for specialist handler, unknown hurdles jumping ability
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 in points but runner-up in her last two outings; makes hurdling debut now for top point-to-point handler.

runners_data.name: Likeyouhaveplenty
runners_data.note: Poor jumping form when pulled up last time, hold-up style unlikely to overcome fundamental flaws
runners_data.spotlight: Poor jumping on show when pulled up at Tramore; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Royal Order
runners_data.note: Debut runner with strong staying pedigree but unlikely to show best immediately
runners_data.spotlight: Dam 2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Benefit Run, out of 2m/2m1f chase winner; unlikely to make an immediate impact.

runners_data.name: Barstool Prophet
runners_data.note: Crystal Ocean filly showed nothing on bumper debut, needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: E30,000 3yo, third foal; dam a bumper/chase winner by Kings Theatre; cheekpieces fitted
runners_data.spotlight: Purchased for 30,000euros as a 3yo; Crystal Ocean filly showed nothing on bumper debut here and needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Fennors Rose
runners_data.note: Well-bred Cian Collins debutante with winning family connections
runners_data.spotlight: Jukebox Jury filly; unsold for 10,500euros as foal; half-sister to six winners inc Fennor Cross (1m-10.3f Flat, RPR 87; useful 2m-2m4f hurdle), Dune Buggy (Italian 8.5f-9.5f) and Infinity Focus (Italian 7.5f-11.4f inc 2yo); dam unraced half-sister to useful 1m2f winner Nurture; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Free A Minute
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer winless in points but showed credit in Cork bumper
runners_data.comment: 0-5 in points and yet to trouble the judge, dam related to bumper winners, others stronger
runners_data.spotlight: Winless from eight point-to-point starts; some credit in her Cork bumper run, although well beaten; a lot of improvement required.

runners_data.name: Yolanda's Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but limited ability shown, 100-1 on debut suggests modest talent
runners_data.comment: Dam half-sister to smart bumper and 2m4f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Livelovelaugh; watch
runners_data.spotlight: Tenth of 15 on debut at Downpatrick when 100-1; not totally devoid of promise, but not appealing at the same time.

runners_data.name: Bold Reflection
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long layoff after Hexham pull-up, market will tell
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner in 2022; returns from very long absence but in weak race; betting may guide
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two points and won a bumper in 2022; returned from almost three years off the track at Hexham when pulled up; just 7-1 that day, so perhaps she can come on for it.

runners_data.name: Julie Liath
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent performer with recent point win, good going record
runners_data.comment: Ran okay in pair of point-to-point bumpers and won a point last time; hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran mare made the breakthrough on her seventh point-to-point start at Dromahane in April and backed that up with a third of 16 at Killarney (2m7f, good to yielding) on hurdles bow last time; place chance.

runners_data.name: Working Away
runners_data.note: Gordon Elliott's expensive purchase returning from 194-day break, unknown current form
runners_data.comment: Off for long time after 2022 point win, beaten 11l at Tramore in Nov', a bit to prove now
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; point winner in 2022 and subsequently bought for 330,000GBP; not seen again until November 2025 when beaten 47l in a 2m4f Cork maiden hurdle (yielding); a bit better later that month at Tramore; back from another break now with a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Between Friends
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with decent hurdles form, 182 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Takes step up in trip for h'cap debut having stayed on in previous runs; check market
runners_data.spotlight: Took runner-up spot at Kilbeggan on second hurdle start (2m1f, yielding) and caught the eye of the stewarsd at last year's festival here ; tailed off at Naas in November and pulled up at Cork (2m4f, soft to heavy) on handicap bow; this is weak, so she's in the mix, but others preferred.

runners_data.name: Some Pretender
runners_data.note: Mullins-trained prominent runner, former bumper winner but disappointing lately
runners_data.comment: Third to Belladaball at Fairyhouse; hard to see her reversing that form on same terms
runners_data.spotlight: Debut Galway festival bumper winner last season before running solid races for third in three subsequent Listed bumpers without showing much progress; tailed off in a Grade 3 contest here at the festival most recently; makes hurdling debut in a weak grade and her win came on good ground; bred to appreciate this trip; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Prophetess Miriam
runners_data.note: Front-runner with sole early pace, recent poor form but tactical advantage
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner showed promise in a point and when runner-up in two bumpers; may improve on tailed-off finish at Killarney on hurdles bow when returning from a break; hood goes on.

runners_data.name: Santa Paula
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor form and 655 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Beat just one rival in two bumpers and fell in a point-to-point back from a 641-day absence last time; unlikely.

runners_data.name: Crossbar Getaway
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with best recent form, 1.25-length second last time out
runners_data.comment: Needs to improve on hurdles form of last summer but ground to suit on return
runners_data.spotlight: Some okay runs in bumpers last summer and ran her best race over hurdles back from a break at Clonmel (2m1f, good to yielding) last time when a 1.25l second of 18; big player if staying this new trip and finding improvement from that first run back.

runners_data.name: Tenacious Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but moderate ability, needs handicap mark to be competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten in two bumpers; two hurdle runs indicate she will need a handicap mark to have winning prospects.

runners_data.name: Latopix
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with French flat win but modest hurdles form
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 1m4f in France; modest form in two bumper starts in Britain; didn't build on promising hurdling debut third at Gowran (2m, heavy) when tailed off at Navan in December (2m, soft to heavy).

runners_data.name: Bossy Bird
runners_data.note: Unknown style with poor form and tendency to fade in finishes
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in a Fairyhouse bumper and a 2m4f maiden hurdle at Bellewstown; got to within 27l of the winner at Roscommon last time; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Cherry Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with woeful record, 1215 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden pointer has been tailed off in all starts under rules and failed to complete two point-to-points since returning from long absence.

races.paceDynamic: Prophetess Miriam is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from flag to finish without pressure. With a large field of 19 runners but limited early pace, she'll create a sustainable tempo that allows the field to stay bunched longer than usual. The lack of pace competition means hold-up horses like Crossbar Getaway, Between Friends, and Free A Minute can be positioned perfectly for late charges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can exploit the predictable, measured gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Prophetess Miriam jumps well and maintains her lead throughout
scenarios.body: She gets an easy lead and sustainable fractions that allow her to kick clear approaching the last. Her front-running style becomes a decisive advantage when she's not pressured for pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow and hold-up horses get ideal positioning
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows closers to be placed perfectly and unleash finishing kicks up the run-in. Crossbar Getaway and Between Friends benefit most from patient rides and strong finishes.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can track Prophetess Miriam and pounce
scenarios.body: Julie Liath or Some Pretender sit close enough to the pace to strike when the leader weakens. Their tactical position proves superior to horses held too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the uncontested pace allows an unconsidered runner to sneak up
scenarios.body: The steady gallop brings stamina types into play and allows lightly-raced horses to show their true ability. Hello Below or Fennors Rose could exploit the tactical setup.

watchPoints.text: Prophetess Miriam's jumping ability under pressure - any mistake could end her front-running advantage
Crossbar Getaway's positioning through the early stages given her hold-up style and best recent form
Working Away's fitness level after 194-day absence for Gordon Elliott following expensive purchase
Market support for Hello Below making hurdling debut from pointing success
Bold Reflection's market price after returning from Hexham pull-up to indicate expectations

races.name: John Dowling Memorial Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: C Pas Possible
runners_data.note: Well-bred newcomer from shrewd connections but unproven over hurdles and 21 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000euros 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother to smart 2m hurdle/2m4f chase winner Lombron; dam unraced half-sister to French 1m7f hurdle winner Omessa Has, out of half-sister to Listed-placed 1m4f Flat and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Enfant De Lune; last of five finishers on point debut last month.

runners_data.name: Les Issards
runners_data.note: Another debutant with point form but 77 days away and trainer struggling for winners recently
runners_data.spotlight: 21,000euros 2yo, 20,000euros 3yo, and bought for 28,000euros in April following his third-place finish in his first point-to-point; dam 1m3f-1m4f AQPS Flat winner, half-sister to winners Vieux Frere (French 2m1f-2m5f hurdle/chase) and As Tu Vu (1m4f AQPS Flat); check market for rules bow.

runners_data.name: Talladega
runners_data.note: Failed to complete in three points and impossible to recommend despite Colin Bowe training
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete all three points; impossible to fancy.

runners_data.name: Will Wilde
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to form after 501-day absence, cheekpieces removed suggests confidence
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner has been off the track 501 days and is best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Looked promising when winning a Sligo bumper in 2023; pulled up back from 501 days away over 3m here last month (17-2); cheekpieces worn that day now left off.

runners_data.name: Jerry From Kerry
runners_data.note: Top-rated with solid hurdle form and likes to race prominently, key contender despite 12-day turnaround
runners_data.comment: Course bumper winner, promising run at Killarney latest, rated 110, could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Ballinrobe bumper winner for Emmet Mullins and top-rated of these; best of four hurdle runs came on penultimate at Killarney last month when an 11l fourth but didn't build on that back at scene of his win when making some jumping errors; can't be dismissed.

runners_data.name: Glenary Prince
runners_data.note: Tailed off on debut but represents Henry De Bromhead who excels with improvers
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off on hurdling debut at Fairyhouse in April (2m4f, yielding to soft); in good hands but may need more time.

runners_data.name: Little Big John
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but poor recent form and hood applied suggests connections concerned
runners_data.comment: Pulled up and tailed off on first two starts; hood and tongue-tie on now
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up and tailed off at Fairyhouse and Clonmel on first two starts; hood reached for; well held in a similar race at this course yesterday.

runners_data.name: Maison De Balzac
runners_data.note: Experienced pointer but fades late and tailed off on rules debut 13 days ago
runners_data.comment: 1-10 in points for Colin Bowe, probably up against it on Rules' debut
runners_data.spotlight: Experienced point-to-pointer; 1-10 in that sphere for Colin Bowe; tailed off on rules bow last time; unlikely.

runners_data.name: Ajp Falco
runners_data.note: Likely pacemaker but fading tendency and no impact in previous starts over obstacles
runners_data.comment: 33-1 and beaten when falling on hurdles debut at Clonmel, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: No impact in bumpers; beaten when fell on hurdling bow at Clonmel and pulled up at Listowel last time.

runners_data.name: Le Questionnaire
runners_data.note: Progressive type from Elliott yard with two recent seconds, trip should suit better
runners_data.comment: No match for winner at Tramore (16.5f, good to yielding) but finished clear of remainder
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in both points and runner-up over hurdles in his last two starts; finished clear of the remainder at Tramore and shaped as though this trip could get more from him when keeping on over 2m3f at Downpatrick last time; ground suits; big player.

runners_data.name: Captain Hanley
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with promising hurdle debut despite Flat disappointments, head gear applied
runners_data.comment: Weak form on the Flat, vastly improved on hurdles debut and the form has been boosted
runners_data.spotlight: 0-18 on Flat but promising introduction to hurdling at Clonmel when staying on well to take the runner-up spot despite suffering interference (2m4f, good to yielding) and the winner easily followed up next time; unseated at the second when saddle slipped at Kilbeggan; worth another chance, although trip is an unknown.

runners_data.name: Raleagh Scope
runners_data.note: Fading type with poor recent record but new headgear suggests last chance saloon
runners_data.comment: Never a factor in four starts under rules last year and no show in five points; blinkers
runners_data.spotlight: Never a factor in four starts under rules last year nor in five points since February; 29l behind at Downpatrick last time; new headgear tried but hard to make a case for him.

races.paceDynamic: Ajp Falco will likely take them along at a steady gallop with Will Wilde and Jerry From Kerry tracking in behind, creating a manageable tempo over this extended trip. The pace should be sustainable rather than punishing, with no obvious tearaway types in the field. Le Questionnaire and Captain Hanley will settle further back looking to use their finishing kick, while the inexperienced types will need to find their position early. This moderate pace setup strongly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as there won't be enough tempo to set up a strong finish for the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady throughout with Ajp Falco setting uncontested fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the field and have enough left to repel late challengers over this stamina-sapping trip. Jerry From Kerry and Will Wilde are perfectly positioned to capitalize on their class edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even more sedate than expected in the middle section
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong gallop they need in the final half-mile to showcase their finishing speed. Captain Hanley's promising debut and Le Questionnaire's recent form make them dangerous if the race falls apart late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Inexperienced Type Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the more fancied runners fail to handle the test or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: One of the lightly-raced types benefits from a smooth round of jumping and the experience of their connections. C Pas Possible from the Griffin yard or Les Issards could exploit any market leader mishaps.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Ajp Falco goes off too fast early or several runners make serious blunders
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test with the winner coming from those who jump cleanly and stay the trip best. Raleagh Scope or Glenary Prince could benefit from a messy contest despite their limitations.

watchPoints.text: Jerry From Kerry running on just 12 days turnaround after his Ballinrobe effort - stamina reserves could be compromised
Captain Hanley needs clean jumping on just his second hurdle start as any mistake will end his chances from the rear
Will Wilde's cheekpieces removal after being pulled up suggests connections happy with his fitness levels
Ajp Falco setting the pace but his fading tendency means he could stop quickly if pressed
Le Questionnaire's finishing kick timing will be crucial as he needs the leaders to come back to him late

races.name: TRM Supporting Every Stride Of The Journey Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Jackmoon
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid recent form who should get ideal position tracking Maverick Mack
runners_data.spotlight: Still searching for a first win but had some good bumper form early on and hasn't done a lot wrong over hurdles; went close in 2m7f maiden in April and solid third over 3m at Wexford when favourite for handicap debut; should be thereabouts with 7lb claimer back on.

runners_data.name: Ottoman Style
runners_data.note: Lightly raced 10-year-old returning to form after encouraging Kilbeggan comeback, handles this ground well
runners_data.comment: Lightly campaigned since dual 2023 wins, but poor in what he has shown
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced since winning back-to-back 2m4f handicaps in 2023; after six months off, his Kilbeggan comeback was encouraging and he's on a good mark if he comes forward from that.

runners_data.name: Good World
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won at Fairyhouse in November but may struggle to make up ground from the rear
runners_data.comment: Five-time hurdles winner, limited chasing experience but potentially well handicapped
runners_data.spotlight: Latest of five wins was at Fairyhouse in November; pulled up over fences last time; handles good ground and has won over 3m; trainer has said that once he goes over mark of 100, he struggles, but claim will help.

runners_data.name: Maverick Mack
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who will dictate pace but question marks over stamina at this extended trip
runners_data.comment: Heavy ground maiden hurdle winner, unseated early on h'cap debut latest, bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Touched off in a point on nice ground; maiden winner over 2m on heavy; well held over 2m4f next time and hasn't got far in two starts this year.

runners_data.name: Falcon Eight
runners_data.note: Classy but aging stayer who was unseated at festival, infrequent runner with fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Seven Flat wins, at the veteran stage now, four seasons since his only hurdles success
runners_data.spotlight: Classy stayer on the Flat but getting long in the tooth; infrequent runner over hurdles nowadays and was well behind when unseating late on at the festival here.

runners_data.name: Streets Of Doyen
runners_data.note: Seven-time winner making stable debut for McConnell but best years behind him
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-time winner but best years are behind him and didn't show much in points last term; stable debut.

runners_data.name: Accustomed
runners_data.note: Best form over 2m4f but trying longer trip with headgear removed, inconsistent recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Narrowly denied on penultimate, pulled up latest, blinkers on, 2lb wrong
runners_data.spotlight: Best form is over 2m4f, inclduing when runner-up in Down Royal handicap in March; has run poorly since and tries longer trip here with headgear removed; did win a soft-ground point over 3m.

runners_data.name: Beyond Your Dreams
runners_data.note: Struggled since Fred Winter run but first-time blinkers and step up in trip could help
runners_data.comment: Has tended to struggle in handicaps, plenty to find with Theflyingbee on recent running
runners_data.spotlight: Flat and 2m maiden hurdle winner was only beaten 10l in last year's Fred Winter, but has struggled since; while going a longer trip in first-time blinkers wouldn't be everyone's cup of tea, perhaps the trainer knows better.

runners_data.name: William Tell
runners_data.note: Represents in-form David Kelly stable and should improve for Killarney return 27 days ago
runners_data.comment: Maiden/novice winner whose latest run in December was too bad to be true
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden and 2m6f novice winner last year represents a stable in fine form and will be better for last month's Killarney return.

runners_data.name: Smackwater Jack
runners_data.note: Won this race last year but 13lb higher in weights and poorly beaten in recent starts
runners_data.comment: Added second hurdles win over C&D last year; reverts to hurdles after poor chase runs
runners_data.spotlight: Won a division of this last year off 92 and he's higher here as a result of being 13lb wrong; well beaten in recent starts.

runners_data.name: Morell River

runners_data.name: Juke Hill
runners_data.note: Back from 129-day break with question marks over fitness for Elliott stable
runners_data.comment: Second reserve; three okay runs in maiden hurdles; unsuited by heavy on h'cap debut lto
runners_data.spotlight: Some fair runs in maidens and heavy ground probably to blame when well-beaten joint-favourite on handicap debut in January; back from a break.

runners_data.name: Work Place
runners_data.note: Consistently beaten by huge margins with only headgear change offering hope
runners_data.comment: Tailed off on handicap debut In March 2025, down 4lb but off since, hard to fancy for now
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten not less than 40l all starts, so the fitting of headgear is the only hope.

races.paceDynamic: Maverick Mack will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to pressure him, allowing Gordon Elliott's charge to dictate a measured gallop through the early stages. The prominent runners Jackmoon, Ottoman Style, William Tell and Streets Of Doyen will track the leader in the first half-dozen, while the hold-up horses Good World, Beyond Your Dreams, Falcon Eight, Morell River and Juke Hill will settle towards the rear. With Maverick Mack likely to string them out turning for home after setting his own fractions, this race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can track the pace and strike when it counts, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to make up significant ground from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Maverick Mack sets a reasonable gallop and maintains his lead into the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leader and can quicken past him in the final furlong. Jackmoon and Ottoman Style are perfectly positioned to capitalize on their superior class ratings when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Maverick Mack's early lead is uncontested and he kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The 5-year-old gets an easy lead and has enough in reserve to see off challenges, with the hold-up horses struggling to close from too far back. His recent point win suggests he has the stamina for this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Benefits Stayers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes a slog and the 2m7½f trip stretches the field
scenarios.body: Good World's 3m winning form comes to the fore as shorter-trip specialists fade, with Morell River's family stamina also proving crucial. The longer distance exposes those better over 2m4f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse Opens Door
scenarios.trigger: If Maverick Mack stops quickly and the prominent horses fail to capitalize
scenarios.body: Beyond Your Dreams or Juke Hill benefit from the pace collapse with fresh legs from the rear, though both need significant improvement. The first-time blinkers on Beyond Your Dreams could spark revival.

watchPoints.text: Maverick Mack's stamina at 2m7½f is unproven and he could stop quickly if going too fast early
Beyond Your Dreams wearing first-time blinkers after 133 days off could either spark improvement or cause problems
Ottoman Style making just second start back from six-month layoff so fitness levels need monitoring
Good World's jumping after being pulled up over fences last time needs careful observation
Several hold-up horses including Juke Hill and Falcon Eight returning from lengthy breaks with fitness doubts

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Are You There

runners_data.spotlight: Closely related to winners Hardwired (2m1f-2m7f hurdle/chase) and Be Fierce (1m7f chase/2m hurdle); half-sister to dual bumper and maiden hurdle winner Friary Road; dam bumper (inc Listed) and 2m/2m2f hurdle winner, out of unraced sister to high-class French 1m-10.5f winner Act One; late debut for daughter of Pour Moi.

runners_data.name: Hope And Mercy

runners_data.spotlight: Idaho mare out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Go Roger Go; 40s for Galway festival bumper, towards rear when losing her rider 4f out; tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: False Dawn
runners_data.note: Another newcomer with unknown ability, trainer has 100% strike rate recently but small sample size.
runners_data.spotlight: Ballylinch-bred Make Believe filly cost E35,000 as a yearling; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to 7f/1m winner Kinver Edge, out of US 1m Grade 3 winning sister to US 1m Grade 1 winner Jack Milton; unraced for Ken Condon.

runners_data.name: Saoirses Choice
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who was fair fourth at Limerick last time, faces similar tactical challenge to other back markers.
runners_data.comment: Elusive Pimpernel mare; dam 6f AW winner, yard 0-5 in bumpers last five seasons
runners_data.spotlight: Fair start at Limerick recently when fourth of 8, but was over 11l off Brave Lady then.

runners_data.name: Big Budgie
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with concerning finishing record, long absence and poor recent form make her hard to fancy.
runners_data.spotlight: 50s, beaten 33l in Kilbeggan bumper over a year ago.

runners_data.name: Brave Lady
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who ran well at Limerick behind useful winner, lacks the rating to match Al Arrivee but tactical position helps.
runners_data.comment: Promise on debut at Galway last year, out of depth latest, could do better now
runners_data.spotlight: Good start when placed at Galway last summer; 66-1 when outclassed in Aintree Grade 2 in April; 6-4 at Limerick when beaten by market rival who looks a useful prospect.

runners_data.name: Al Arrivee

runners_data.comment: Absent since Galway festival second last summer; top amateur rider booked

runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten on debut but only 8-1 at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) where she made all with Elliott and Mullins supplying the placed horses.

runners_data.name: Any News For Me
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced with poor finishing record in previous bumpers, needs much stronger pace than likely here.
runners_data.comment: Met some interference off the home turn first time out at Leopardstown, may improve
runners_data.spotlight: Wasn't been beaten out the gate by any means in winter bumpers at Leopardstown and Navan, but unlikely to contend all the same.

runners_data.name: Freya Cova
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with poor debut form and concerning finishing ability, hood suggests trainer concerns about attitude.
runners_data.comment: Free Eagle mare, yard not known for bumper winners but very well bred, check market
runners_data.spotlight: From a good family and is sister to smart bumper performer Windbeneathmywings; tailed off on debut at Down Royal; hood.

races.paceDynamic: Coco's Legacy is the confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start with no obvious pace pressure in this small field. Brave Lady and Al Arrivee will sit prominent but neither looks keen to challenge early, while the majority including Hope And Mercy, Saoirses Choice and Big Budgie prefer to come from behind. This sets up a race where the pace-setter gets an easy lead and kicks clear, creating a tempo that will test the finishing speed of the hold-up horses on good to soft ground. The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the action.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Coco's Legacy gets an uncontested lead and maintains momentum.
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable advantage through weak fractions while the hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back. Her recent Downpatrick victory in similar conditions where she made all confirms this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Al Arrivee or Brave Lady track the leader and produce superior finishing speed.
scenarios.body: The Mullins-trained Al Arrivee has the class edge and proven stamina to overhaul Coco's Legacy in the final furlong, while Brave Lady lacks the rating to match her. Al Arrivee's half-sister connection to Al Boum Photo suggests the distance and ground suit perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners set stronger fractions and the race develops into a stamina test.
scenarios.body: Hope And Mercy or Saoirses Choice could benefit from a truly-run race where their closing style becomes effective late on. However, the lack of early pace makes this scenario less likely on the evidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Are You There or False Dawn show significantly more ability than their breeding suggests.
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced newcomers could possess hidden talent but face the disadvantage of inexperience in what looks a tactical affair. Their unknown quantities make them dangerous but unlikely given the lack of early pace pressure.

watchPoints.text: Coco's Legacy getting an easy uncontested lead through the first mile could make her unbeatable.
Al Arrivee positioning closer than usual to the pace early could signal Mullins team expects tactical race.
Any significant market support for the two newcomers Are You There or False Dawn would suggest hidden ability.
If Brave Lady or other prominent runners challenge Coco's Legacy early, it could set up the hold-up horses.
Ground conditions staying on good to soft side favour the front runners over horses needing give in surface.
